summary: Canonical direction profile for Sarah voice and talking-avatar generation. Restored from dabc08102f~1:scripts/sarah-avatar/sarah-direction.json and updated for the Coax-native Google Chirp 3 HD + Vertex Imagen + Segmind audio-driven pipeline.
voice_anchor: A woman's voice, distinctly feminine and never masculine.
voice_prompt: A calm, certain, direct register. Grounded and unhurried. Precise consonants, short declarative phrasing, and controlled urgency. Plain professional English with dry warmth; no cheer, sales cadence, sing-song rhythm, or military allegory. Leda's clear, slightly higher voice remains settled and level.
portrait_prompt: Close-up studio portrait of a poised young woman in her late twenties with intense bright blue eyes, long dark-brown hair framing her face, subtle natural skin texture, composed neutral closed-lip expression with steady direct eye contact into the camera. Wearing a dark matte navy-black sci-fi jacket collar with subtle thin glowing cyan accent piping. Cinematic split lighting with warm amber key light on the left cheek and cool cyan rim light on the right cheek, softly blurred dark moody background, fixed camera, photorealistic 85mm portrait lens, clean unobstructed frame.
video_prompt: Composed, still, and direct to camera. Neutral closed-lip expression at rest; no persistent toothy smile. Steady eye contact, restrained natural head movement and blinking synchronized to the spoken audio. Cinematic warm-amber and cool-cyan sci-fi lighting matching the source portrait. Fixed camera.
negative_prompt: big toothy grin, wide open-mouth smile, persistent smile, presenter smile, over-cheerful, bubbly, laughing, giddy, angry glare, sneer, exaggerated expression, subtitles, text, watermark, UI overlay, blurry, distorted face, extra fingers, frozen static face

director_notes.note: Voice deeper, less cheery; smile less toothy; added feminine voice_anchor so low/dry cues never flip gender.
Locked voice to Leda; neutral direct expression; prefer continuous takes up to 60s, hiding joins under full-screen cutaways.
Retired military/battle allegory from ordinary register; plain assertive professional English across both video and live voice.
Audio-first architecture: synthesize and QA-gate Sarah's locked Google Chirp 3 HD Leda track before driving portrait lip-sync models; enforce SQ-1 playback-first scoreboard.
